related_questions.question: What is the 7 pay rule for life insurance?
related_questions.snippet: The amount you can put into your life insurance policy before it becomes a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) is determined by the IRS's 7-pay test. This test calculates whether the total premiums paid within the first seven years of the policy exceed the maximum amount that would pay up the policy completely.
